segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Dana. Can I get your company name and the last four digits on the account ID?

segments.text: I just need the mailing address for invoices changed from 1440 West Armitage, Suite 210, to 221 South Wacker Drive, Suite 905, Chicago 60606, effective today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure. For verification, can you confirm the primary billing email on the account?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect. I’m in the billing tool now. Okay, that’s updated on account 4187. Future invoice PDFs will use the new details starting with the August 31 invoice.
